A1 horizontal: $F\cos\theta+10-40\cos60^\circ=0$, so $F\cos\theta=10$.
M1: Attempt $\theta=\tan^{-1}(5-2\sqrt3)=\tan^{-1}(1.535898\ldots)$; one missing term in total.
M1: Attempt $F=\sqrt{15.358\ldots^2+10^2}$; one missing term in total.

parts.answer: Magnitude $40-20\sqrt3\,\mathrm{N}$, in the direction of the $50\,\mathrm{N}$ force (vertically downwards).

B1: Resultant $40-20\sqrt3$ N in same direction as the 50 N force; allow vertically downwards, south, $180^\circ$, or negative $y$ direction. Magnitude must be exact and positive, so $20\sqrt3-40$ scores B0.
